description: Use when an agent needs an ERC-20's basics before quoting, transferring or approving it. Input: address; chain (base default, ethereum, arbitrum); optional holder (balance, share of supply) and spender (allowance, flags unlimited). Output: JSON block+time, name, symbol, decimals, totalSupply, known issuer if curated. Name/symbol are self-reported. EOA or non-ERC-20: 4xx, not charged. Example: ?address=0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913 Price: $0.002 USDC (Base or Solana) via x402.

address.description: ERC-20 token contract on the chosen chain (0x + 40 hex; mixed case must be a valid EIP-55 checksum). EOA → 400, non-ERC-20 contract → 422 (not charged)

holder.description: Optional address whose token balance and share of total supply to include

spender.description: Optional spender; with holder, adds allowance(holder, spender). Needs holder.

name: base_token_info
title: ERC-20 token info on Base, Ethereum or Arbitrum: name, symbol, decimals, total supply, optional holder balance and allowance
